description: Config for lib/text-to-clean-english/ (owner decision 2026-09-30, updated 2026-10-01): a host step that runs BEFORE the small formalizer -- AGENTS.md 'Model boundary' still holds, the formalizer's own input stays exactly the user's message, added only after this step has replaced it with a cleaned English version (or left it unchanged). The message is split into sentences (lib/sentence-split.mjs); each sentence is gated (lib/text-to-clean-english/gate.mjs, LanguagesUtil only) and only sentences the gate flags go to a backend. `enabled: false` turns the whole step off (backend 'none', no model call). `backends.english`/`backends.nonEnglish` choose which lib/text-to-clean-english/backends/<id>.mjs handles a flagged sentence by whether it has a non-English signal: `llm` is LanguageProofingLLM, the fine-tuned Gemma 3 270M of run language-proofing-gemma270m-prod1 (registry model `llm.model` in config/formalizers.json, capability `proofread`, started on demand, message-only prompt, one sentence per request; report eval/reports/current/language-proofing-prod1/summary.md); `languagetool` is an OPTIONAL backend, off by default (set `backends.english` to `languagetool` and start it with `node tools/languagetool-server.mjs --port 18123`; `languagetool.url` names that port); `none` disables cleaning for that class. `llm.sendAll: true` (default since 2026-10-01: the gate recalls only about 28% of the sentences that need cleaning, so, per the owner rule 'if uncertainty cannot be detected, always', every sentence goes to the model) sends EVERY sentence, clean ones too (the model changes about 0.2% of clean sentences; each clean-sentence call costs about 110 ms on 4 CPU threads); `false` sends only gated sentences. `llm.skipGreetings: true` (default) skips the model for a sentence that is only a greeting or a thanks (hello, hi, good morning, thank you, bye) when LanguagesUtil marks it English and the gate finds it clean, whatever `sendAll` says (reported in `skipped`). An unreachable backend leaves the message unchanged. OWNER DECISION 2026-10-01 (journaled): `backends.nonEnglish` is `translator-llm` (registry model `translator.model`, capability `translate-clean`: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M, one sentence per request, the translate prompt of translate-compare; 64.9% of 425 natural sentences keep their meaning against 10.6% for prod1, `eval/reports/current/translate-compare/summary.md`); a sentence is routed by its LanguagesUtil language: Romanian or mixed to the translator, English to `backends.english` (prod1, `llm.sendAll` semantics unchanged). `translator.fallback` (`llm`, or `none`) names the backend that takes a sentence when the translator cannot start or fails; the substitution is reported in the result (`fallback`, `routes`), the API trace and the chat note.
